stories.title: Puerto Vallarta vive una tensa calma ante la llegada del Huracán "Simón"; turistas y pobladores se alistan para el embate

en.title: Puerto Vallarta experiences tense calm ahead of Hurricane "Simón"; tourists and residents prepare for impact
en.summary: Residents and tourists in Puerto Vallarta are preparing for Hurricane Simón's arrival on Jalisco's coast through panic buying, long lines at gas stations, and businesses reinforcing their storefronts.

stories.title: Muere policía de Filadelfia y otro resulta herido tras reporte de hombre armado; hay un sospechoso detenido

en.title: Philadelphia police officer dies and another is wounded following armed man report; one suspect detained
en.summary: A Philadelphia police officer was killed and another wounded during an incident involving a reported armed individual, with one suspect taken into custody.

stories.title: Anuncian trabajadores del IMSS marcha el 14 de octubre

en.title: IMSS workers announce march on October 14
en.summary: IMSS employees plan a demonstration on October 14 across 32 states to protest against a union consultation regarding salary increases that they consider illegitimate.

stories.title: Personal del IMSS anuncia marcha nacional el 14 de octubre; trabajadores del Metro, Pemex, ISSSTE y CNTE se suman

en.title: IMSS staff announces national march on October 14; Metro, Pemex, ISSSTE and CNTE workers join
en.summary: IMSS personnel and workers from Metro, Pemex, ISSSTE and CNTE plan a national march on October 14, following recent medical staff protests demanding better working conditions.

stories.title: Isaías toca tierra como huracán categoría 2 en la costa de EU

en.title: Hurricane Isaías makes landfall as Category 2 storm on US coast
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías made landfall Friday night as a Category 2 hurricane on the Gulf of Mexico coast of the United States.

stories.title: Reportan compras de pánico y largas filas en gasolineras ante llegada del huracán “Simón” a Puerto Vallarta; se esperan lluvias y fuertes vientos

en.title: Panic buying reported and long lines at gas stations as Hurricane Simón approaches Puerto Vallarta; heavy rains and strong winds expected
en.summary: Residents in Puerto Vallarta experienced panic buying and extended lines at gas stations ahead of Hurricane Simón's arrival, with forecasts for heavy rainfall and strong winds.

stories.title: Hombre muere tras ser atacado por un tigre en zoológico británico; él ingresó al recinto de los ejemplares en peligro de extinción

en.title: Man dies after being attacked by tiger at British zoo; he entered the enclosure of endangered specimens
en.summary: A man died after being attacked by a tiger at a British zoo after entering the enclosure housing endangered animals.

stories.title: No todos los que ganan encuestas sirven a la causa.- Durazo

en.title: Not everyone who wins polls serves the cause: Durazo
en.summary: During a Morena party council meeting, Durazo stated that winning polls does not guarantee commitment and questioned candidates who pay for positioning.

stories.title: Hombre entra a recinto de tigres en zoológico británico y muere tras ataque

en.title: Man enters tiger enclosure at British zoo and dies after attack
en.summary: A person died after entering the tiger area at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in England and sustaining fatal injuries. The tiger remained in its enclosure during the incident.

stories.title: Hay quienes ganan las encuestas porque pagan y no porque caminan con el pueblo, dice Durazo; arranca Consejo Nacional de Morena

en.title: Some win polls because they pay, not because they walk with the people, says Durazo; Morena National Council begins
en.summary: The National Council president stated that certain candidates achieve high poll numbers through artificial preference inflation rather than genuine grassroots support.

stories.title: Huracán Simón: gobernadores refuerzan medidas de prevención ante lluvias intensas en el Pacífico

en.title: Hurricane Simón: governors strengthen prevention measures ahead of intense rainfall in the Pacific
en.summary: Mexican state governors implemented emergency protocols including activity suspensions and mobility restrictions as Hurricane Simón threatened coastal regions. Federal authorities activated preventive measures across multiple municipalities.

stories.title: Huracán Simon ya es categoría 4; alerta en Jalisco y Colima

en.title: Hurricane Simon now Category 4; alerts in Jalisco and Colima
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified to Category 4 off Mexico's central Pacific coast and is expected to strengthen further, with heavy to torrential rains forecast for western and southern regions including Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima, Jalisco, and Nayarit.

stories.title: Nerds llega oficialmente a México tras años de venta por distribuidores

en.title: Nerds officially arrives in Mexico after years of distributor sales
en.summary: Ferrara Candy Company's Nerds brand launched official operations in Mexico with a strategy combining diverse product formats and marketing activations to build consumer presence.

stories.title: Mantendrá México de las inflaciones médicas más altas en América Latina en 2027

en.title: Mexico to Maintain One of the Highest Medical Inflation Rates in Latin America in 2027
en.summary: Mexico is projected to have one of the highest medical inflation rates in Latin America in 2027, with increases far exceeding general inflation, though at a slower pace than 2026, continuing pressure on business and household budgets.

stories.title: Hacienda baja el IEPS para gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su quinta semana con cuota cero

en.title: Treasury lowers IEPS for gasoline, while diesel reaches its fifth week with zero tax
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury reduced the special tax on gasoline for the week of October 10-16, with Magna gasoline taxed at 2.39 pesos per liter and Premium at 1.62 pesos, while diesel maintains zero taxation.

stories.title: De equipo de adolescentes a negocio de 490 millones: cómo los Azcárraga convirtieron al América en un imperio

en.title: From teenage team to 490 million business: how the Azcárragas turned América into an empire
en.summary: Club América has evolved from a sports team into a financial asset, with the Azcárraga family now seeking to monetize its fan base, stadium, and brand value.

stories.title: Antes de Chivas y Omnilife, Jorge Vergara se levantaba a las 4:00 de la mañana para vender carnitas

en.title: Before Chivas and Omnilife, Jorge Vergara woke at 4:00 AM to sell carnitas
en.summary: Jorge Vergara faced financial failure early in his career and sold carnitas in the early morning hours before founding his successful companies Chivas and Omnilife.
